articleTitle: Concept of Passive and Post-Accident Part Assessment for Non-Commercial Vehicles Integrated Safety Design
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article describes the basics of the proposed new scientific concept of rating the passive (and post-accident) part of the integrated safety of non-commercial vehicles. The concept is based on the application of a new criterion characterizing the level of passive safety of the vehicle structure in the selected test scenario. As a new comprehensive criterion for the passive safety of a car, it is proposed to apply not the criteria for organ damage under fixed collision conditions, but the speed of the car, at which the limit criteria for organ damage will not be exceeded. The concept of forming a new methodology for the independent assessment of the level of passive safety of non-commercial vehicles of the M1 category is presented. The issues of the correctness of evaluating the effectiveness of active (preventive) safety measures are also taken into account. An objective, scientifically based distribution of the weight of assessments of the active and passive parts of the integrated safety of the car is proposed. The problems arising in the practical implementation of a new scientific concept are described and ways to overcome them are proposed.

articleTitle: Multi-Criteria Analysis of Genetic Algorithm Applications in Transportation Logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper investigates the application of genetic algorithms (GAs) in the multi-criteria optimization of transportation networks, with a focus on their role in logistics management. Key considerations include fuel expenses, trip duration, environmental regulations, and vehicle maintenance. The paper provides a detailed examination of the objective function, which includes factors such as loading and unloading queues, traffic congestion, unexpected events, and other variables. Additionally, the paper presents a comparative analysis of various optimization methods, highlighting the benefits of GAs in reducing costs and improving delivery efficiency. The research delves into how genetic algorithms can be utilized for optimizing transportation systems by addressing cost control, delivery timelines, and environmental impact. The objective function discussed covers aspects such as fuel consumption, vehicle upkeep, waiting times, and other critical elements. The paper also offers a succinct comparative analysis of alternative optimization techniques, supported by graphical representations of the results. This comparison aims to showcase the effectiveness of genetic algorithms in solving complex multi-criteria problems and to emphasize their advantages over conventional methods.

articleTitle: Data Acquisition System for Multichannel Fourier Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article discusses the reasons for the development of multichannel fiber-optic Fourier spectrometers and data acquisition systems (DAQs) for them. One of the main requirements for DAQs is formulated - simultaneous sampling of channel sensors. Examples of two-channel simultaneous sampling Fourier spectrometers and technologies of DAQs are given. The rejection of third-party DAQs is justified. The key design points determining the novelty and advantages of the system under development are considered: choosing the number of channels, selecting the type of ADC, selecting the type of computer communication interface, the choice of programming tools. A functional electrical circuit of a multichannel Fourier spectrometer and the structure of the data collection system with ARM core microcontroller as well as the stages of programming the latter are described. Preliminary tests of the data DAQ with simulation of three channels have been carried out one of which was the measuring channel of the Infraspec FSM 2211 spectrometer.

articleTitle: Attenuated Total Reflection Fiber Probes for Real-Time Measurements in the Mid-Infrared Range
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article discusses the possibility of using fiber-optic probes with attenuated total reflection (ATR) crystals to study substances in liquid and gaseous phases in the mid-infrared (mid-IR) range. This attachment allow real-time in-situ measurements to be performed in a wide temperature range without sample preparation. The operating principle of the ATR technique is described. The comparative analysis of the crystals and waveguides materials for the mid-IR range is performed. The fiber-coupled Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectrometer is proposed.

articleTitle: Restoration of the Impulse Profile in the Remote Monitoring System of Technical Facilities
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article is dedicated to the examination of effective methods for assessing the original signal profile, distorted during transmission in an optical system, in terms of speed and error reduction. Light pulses undergo degradation in the form of parameter changes while propagating through various media and being registered by photodetectors. The restoration of such parameters, as well as the original profile of the pulses themselves, can be viewed as a deconvolution task and is important in the development and creation of optical devices for the study and registration of various processes. Such systems are used in the remote diagnostics of technical facilities in industry and automotive engineering. The object of study is a system for registering spectral parameters of fast-paced processes observed using optical fiber probes. An approach has been proposed to assess the original parameters of the signal, based on the analysis of a test pulse and the properties of the system itself. The obtained results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed approach and the possibility of increasing the processing speed and accuracy of analysis for industrial and automotive engineering tasks.

articleTitle: System for Measuring the Transverse Flatness of the Roadway
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Technical means of transverse roughness determination and mathematical methods for processing measurement results are analyzed. The functional capabilities of the transverse roughness measurement system developed by the authors are described, which is a hardware-software complex for measuring the cross flatness of the roadway using laser scanning technology, as well as specialized software that collects, stores, and processes the scanning results in real time. The advantages of the mobile laser scanning technology, the scheme of the hardware-software complex of transverse flatness measurement, and its advantages are given. An example of processing the results of transverse roughness measurement using the specialized software developed by the authors is given.

articleTitle: Management Principles in Intelligent Passenger Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A new approach to managing transportation by an intelligent passenger transport system (IPTS) is proposed. The IPTS functioning is based on the following principles: continuous collection and analysis of transportation demand data; adaptive organization of transportation in real time by an intelligent control system (with minimal human participation); transportation is carried out based on the selection of the optimal transportation plan at the given moment; transportation is performed by unmanned electric cars that can be combined into cassettes, thus forming a new vehicle of the required passenger capacity; passenger transportation in the IPTS combines normal, high-speed and express modes with the prevalence of the high-speed mode, due to which the passenger makes a minimum number of unnecessary stops. The listed principles ensure the efficient use of the carrier’s resources and passenger transportation of increased consumer qualities.

articleTitle: Investigation of Thermopower of Pure Metals and Structural Materials at High Temperatures Aimed to Simulate Electron Beam Welding of Dissimilar Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper presents the results of measuring the thermopower of pure metals (Ni, W) and industrial alloy steels of austenitic, pearlitic and martensitic classes in the temperature range from 100 to 1000°C. A technique for recording the integral thermopower of a chromel-material-under-investigation thermocouple, mathematical processing of experimental data, and determining the absolute thermopower of the material is described; the temperature dependences of the absolute thermopower coefficient for the materials under study are given. The measurement and data processing technique was verified by comparison with thermopower values obtained in other works on pure metals (Ni and W), and showed good agreement between the results. The results of the work can be used to describe the properties of materials in numerical mathematical simulation of technological processes, for example, electron beam welding of dissimilar materials of large thickness. The results of such simulation and their comparison with the results of a full-scale experiment are presented.

articleTitle: Mesodynamic Model of Conflict in Traffic Flow
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article considers the possibility of applying the method of mathematical regression analysis to assess the level of conflict on public roads by approximating data on the state of the environment. As an initial material the study of parameters of temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind speed and solar activity on the UDS in a unified system of calculation is proposed. The selected parameters have a direct impact on the condition of drivers and traffic conditions. Environmental factors are known to influence the probability of traffic accidents, but there are no mathematical tools to describe such conditions and quantitative values. The presented model, based on the analysis of the above data, is designed to solve this problem. Based on the results of the conducted work, a mathematical model is developed and its statistical significance is confirmed through the use of F-criterion. The article discusses the possibility of applying the method of mathematical regression analysis to assess the level of conflict on public roads by approximating data on the state of the external environment. As an initial material the study of parameters of temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind speed and solar activity on the roadway in a unified system of calculation is proposed. The model developed on the basis of the analysis of these data has statistical significance.

articleTitle: Development of a System for Prevention of Collisions of Microtransports with Pedestrians
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The solution to the urgent problem of increasing the safety of compact vehicles, including personal mobility devices on sidewalks and pedestrian paths in the flow of pedestrians, is to create a safety zone. To do this, it is necessary to develop a method of safe (accident-free) movement in confined spaces, through a stream of chaotically moving obstacles (objects), that is, pedestrians.

articleTitle: Efficient Machine Learning Methods for Real-Time Transport System Optimization and Predictive Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This research explores the application of machine learning techniques to enhance real-time transport system optimization and predictive maintenance. By leveraging advanced algorithms and data analysis methods, we aim to create high-performance applications capable of efficiently processing large volumes of traffic data. Our approach involves developing intelligent systems that can automatically adapt to changing conditions and predict potential issues on transport routes. We implement clustering methods, such as k-means, for effective data grouping and pattern recognition. Sophisticated data reduction techniques are employed to optimize dataset management and improve system performance. Specialized technologies like GPUs and cloud platforms are integrated to enhance computational capabilities. We focus on implementing efficient data cleaning processes to filter noisy data tracks and anomalies. The Davis-Boldin index is utilized to assess the quality of clustering in transport nodes. Application-level data transfer protocols are developed for distributed computing environments. TCP stream control algorithms are optimized for improved web service performance. Our methodology addresses challenges in real-time data processing, traffic flow prediction, and system stability. These approaches contribute to the development of more efficient and responsive transport infrastructure management solutions. The proposed methods demonstrate significant potential for improving transportation network performance and reducing operational costs through enhanced predictive maintenance capabilities.

articleTitle: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Improving the Effectiveness of Professional Training of Students of Electrical Engineering and Electronic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article examines the role of artificial intelligence in improving the effectiveness of students' professional training in the field of electrical engineering and electronic engineering. The main trends, prospects and algorithms of an intelligent information and analytical management system are considered, as well as the risks of introducing artificial intelligence into modern education. Special attention is paid to the ethical problems of the application of artificial intelligence and the use of artificial intelligence in higher education. The study shows that the use of artificial intelligence can significantly speed up the process of education and training of specialists in the field of electrical engineering and electronic engineering.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Traffic Situation as a Possible Way to Improve the Effectiveness of ADAS in Urban Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article deals with the issue of increasing of accidents involving personal mobility devices (PMDs). The official statistics of road accidents for 2023 is given. Special attention is paid to the study of the types of road accidents. Attention is focused on the increase in accidents involving personal mobility equipment, especially e-scooters for hire. The issue of taking measures to reduce the number of such road accidents is being raised. As a solution to the problem, the concept of a modified algorithm of functioning of the automatic emergency braking system (AEBS) is proposed, which is able to predict the behavior of road users using PMD and, thus, to reduce the probability of a possible collision of the car with them. Technical prerequisites for the creation of such an algorithm are given. The main elements that are included in the improved algorithm are also given, as well as their brief description.

articleTitle: Reduction of the Transmission Rate of Sound Broadcasting Signals Based on their Modulation Representation
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: A method for reducing the transmission rate of sound broadcasting signals (SBS) is considered, based on the use of modulation parameters of these signals. Proposals are being developed to improve the accuracy of isolating two of its modulation parameters from the SBS – the Hilbert amplitude envelope and the instantaneous frequency. The features of the selected modulation parameters and their significant differences from the initial SBS are shown. A method is proposed to eliminate redundancy from SBS, carried out on the basis of stepwise modulation decomposition of these signals. The features of using the modulation method of decomposition in relation to broadband broadcast signals are considered. It is shown that the modulation representation of wideband SBS can significantly reduce the transmission rate of these signals.

articleTitle: Study of the Influence of Substrate Material and Thickness of Indium Tin Oxide Coatings on Their Optoelectronic Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article presents the results of studies on the influence of substrate material, application parameters, and Indium Tin Oxide (ITO) coating thickness on its functional characteristics (transparency and surface resistance). Coatings of different thicknesses were applied by magnetron sputtering to two types of substrates: glass and polyethylene terephthalate (PET) film. The optical parameters were studied using spectrophotometry (in the visible wavelength range), while the surface resistance was measured using the four-point van der Pauw method. As a result, the optimal values of the application parameters and ITO coating thickness for each type of substrate were determined, balancing transparency and surface resistance, with a view to their subsequent use as transparent electrodes in microelectronics, optoelectronics, acousto-optics, solar energy, and other fields.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Electromagnetic Wave Propagation Characteristics in Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Wireless networks are used indoors by a variety of organizations. During their design, it is necessary to ensure stable communication. The propagation of electromagnetic waves can be affected by various obstacles inside the premises. In addition, interference from other electronic devices may be in the way of propagating signals. It is important to determine if there are dead zones where the signal is not propagating. On the basis of geometric constructions, the possibility of determining dead zones is shown, and their area is estimated. To assess the characteristics of reflection outside the dead zone, it is proposed to use an elementary non-isotropic reflector in the form of a cube, the dimensions of which are in the resonant region. The paper determines the characteristics of scattered fields for such a reflector.

articleTitle: Practical Aspects of Electrical Vehicle Usage on Current Condition
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: number of electrical vehicles (EV) is constantly growing on roads of many countries for several last years. the Nordic countries is not exception in this lane. The main attractive items of EV for customers are modern technology, good dynamic performance and low energy cost. But the solved to check last item. They selected several EVs that is possible to buy in the Nordic countries market, selected several evaluation courses to check energy consumption in different usage condition and measured energy consumption during driving by same driver. Also, results were compared to diesel fuel consumption on same courses. In conclusion: the comparison of electrical energy consumption cost and diesel consumption cost to drive 100 km were done.

articleTitle: Calculation of Natural Vibration Frequencies of a Box Structure with Thermal Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article focuses on calculating the natural vibration frequencies of a box structure with thermal protection, a crucial component in many engineering fields such as mechanical engineering and construction. The thermal protective coating applied to the outer surfaces of the structure adds significant mass and requires consideration in static and dynamic analyses. The study employs nonlinear dynamic analysis to model the flexible, two-layered structure subjected to thermal and force loads. The authors derive a system of nonlinear differential equations for the deflection of the structure using the Bubnov-Galerkin method. They also account for the material properties, including the modulus of elasticity and density of both the box and thermal protection layers. Numerical integration techniques are employed to solve these equations, providing a relationship between dimensionless vibration amplitudes over time. The study demonstrates the applicability of the proposed methodology by calculating the lowest natural frequency for a specific plate configuration and extends this analysis to configurations with stiffening ribs. In conclusion, the approach offers a reliable means for dynamic analysis of similar structures, with potential applications in finite element modeling. The results serve as a reference for validating such models under geometrically nonlinear conditions.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Performance of Using Mobile Roadside Units for Task Offloading in V2X Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of task offloading performance in Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) systems by comparing traditional stationary Roadside Units (RSUs) with mobile RSUs (mRSUs). The study explores how mobile RSUs can enhance data offloading efficiency, reduce latency, and minimize unprocessed requests during peak network loads. By simulating different operational scenarios, the paper highlights the benefits of mRSUs in improving system responsiveness and resilience. Numerical simulations validate the effectiveness of the task offloading mechanism, demonstrating how dynamic allocation of mobile resources can significantly improve overall system performance in V2X environments.

articleTitle: Measurement of Optical Quality Parameters of Crystalline Lithium-Sodium Molybdate
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Lithium-sodium molybdate is a new promising material for creating optical components of high-power laser systems. For such application, the crystals used must be of high optical quality; in particular, they should have high laser-induced damage threshold (LIDT), low optical absorption index and low optical scattering coefficient. This work presents the results of measurement of the above parameters at 1064 nm in crystalline lithium-sodium molybdate. The optical absorption index was measured using piezoelectric resonance laser calorimetry, the optical scattering coefficient was measured using standardized integrating sphere technique, and the laser damage threshold was measured in 1-on-1 test.

articleTitle: Non-Destructive Testing of Resistive Components Using Low-Frequency Noise Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the drift of low-frequency noise power for carbon-based resistive components after electric pulse action. The processing was carried out with single and serial pulses. A low-noise cascade amplifier and an oscilloscope were used to study the low-frequency noise. The level of low-frequency noise was compared with the resistance of the resistive component. The greatest drift of low-frequency noise was recorded when exposed to a pulse sequence. A correlation was established between the change in the low-frequency noise power and the drift of the dissipated power of the resistive component after exposure to an electric pulse. In this case, the low-frequency noise power changed faster than the dissipated power of the resistor. Based on the drift of the studied parameters, a preliminary empirical expression was obtained for predicting the electrophysical parameters of the resistive components. From a scientific and practical point of view, an important result was obtained, which in the future can be used as a non-destructive method for testing the parameters of resistive components.

articleTitle: Forced Transverse Vibrations of a Box Structure from the Action of a Plane Shock Wave, Based on a Flexible Plate Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Box structures are widely used in mechanical engineering, instrumentation, construction and in many branches of human activity. Such structures play a special role in transport engineering, particularly in the automotive industry. Often, the box structure in addition to the force impact, can experience loads of wave influence nature. For reliable operation of a box structure, as well as for the assessment of strength and stiffness, it is necessary to know the dynamic characteristics of the system, in particular, to be able to determine the forms of transverse vibrations under different types of impacts at different moments of time.

articleTitle: Development of a Chemosensor for Measuring Ammonia Concentration Dissolved in Water
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The results of work on the development of a sensor sensitive to ammonia dissolved in water are presented. The well-known Eosin Y was used as the active substance, which had not previously been applied for this purpose and was synthesized by a new method. The study includes the results of absorption and fluorescence spectra analysis of Eosin Y solution, as well as silicone films with the chemosensor, which were pre-immersed in aqueous ammonia solutions of varying concentrations. Sensor prototype tests were conducted, revealing a correlation between fluorescence intensity and the concentration of ammonia dissolved in water, and a calibration curve was constructed. Further research is planned to investigate long-term stability, increase sensitivity, reduce the influence of fluorescence from the silicone substrate, and develop the sensor's design. The ammonia sensor holds promise for applications in environmental monitoring, industry, water supply, agriculture, and aquaculture.

articleTitle: Features of Spectral Analysis Using Complex Discrete Cosine Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The primary method for spectral analysis of the sound broadcasting signal remains the Fast Fourier Transform. One of its drawbacks is insufficient resolution, which does not allow for the assessment of closely spaced spectral components of the sound signal. The resolution of the Discrete Cosine Transform is twice as high, but its use has been limited by the wide spectrum of side lobes. The authors have developed a method for a complex Discrete Cosine Transform with compensation for side lobes and improved accuracy in determining the parameters of spectral components through multiple transpositions of the sound signal spectrum.

articleTitle: Methods and Algorithms for Visualizing the Volumetric Model of an Object Based on its Visible Part
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The research focuses on the use of computer vision and machine learning methods to determine the central axis of symmetry of the object, as well as on the application of various approaches to generate the necessary additions. Special attention is paid to processing images with partially visible objects and improving the accuracy of their restored parts through adaptive algorithms. The presented work demonstrates the convenience and effectiveness of the proposed methods in various scenarios, including the reconstruction of architectural elements, natural objects, and complex artificial structures in comparison with calculations based on the full set of images. The provided examples and experimental data show that the developed approaches can be successfully applied in physics, engineering, and computer vision to solve tasks related to restoring objects from their partial images.

articleTitle: Optimizing Traffic Flow Using Quantum Annealing
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper investigates the use of quantum annealing for optimizing traffic flow, serving as a case study for broader applications in network optimization tasks. We start by modeling the traffic network as a quantum system, where intersections, roads, and traffic parameters are represented as qubits within a quantum annealing framework. The optimization process is outlined, illustrating how the quantum system evolves to identify low-energy states that correspond to optimal traffic flow configurations. By harnessing the unique properties of quantum mechanics, such as superposition and quantum tunneling, quantum annealing has the potential to efficiently explore extensive solution spaces beyond the capabilities of classical algorithms. This research aims to expand the understanding of how quantum computing can be applied to complex network optimization challenges, providing insights that could lead to more efficient, responsive, and sustainable management systems across various domains.

articleTitle: Practical Application Possibility of Holographic Antennas for Adaptive Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In this paper, a perspective method of adaptive beamforming using a reconfigurable holographic feed-through antenna with external horn excitation is considered. This kind of system provides wavefield reception and emission as a result of waves passing through a diffraction plate with controlled amplitude or phase transmittance. The results of numerical modelling show the possibility of increasing the output signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio and suppressing unwanted interference in received signals during plate reconfiguration based on the Cantoni orthogonal perturbation method.

articleTitle: Estimation of Energy Consumption on Urban Access Roads Using the Two-Fluid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This study focuses on estimating energy consumption on access roads to the city of Vologda using the Two-Fluid model. The analysis includes key parameters of the model—n (sensitivity to changes in road conditions), Tf (travel time per unit distance), p (traffic flow comparison coefficient), and e (energy efficiency)—within the context of Vologda’s road network and traffic flows. The results show that these parameters for Vologda differ from the values reported in the literature, indicating the unique characteristics of the local conditions. In particular, n and Tf demonstrate moderate sensitivity and high road service quality, respectively. The parameter p confirms that energy consumption increases with rising traffic congestion, while e suggests higher energy consumption compared to other regions. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for local conditions when applying models to estimate traffic flows and energy consumption, offering a direction for further research in this area.

articleTitle: Spectral Selection System of Narrow Band Radiation of the Excimer KrF Laser
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The work describes the system for spectral filtering of probing radiation for studying the dynamics of photofragments during double-pulse excitation of molecules by the LF/LIF method. The parameters of the special narrow-band excimer KrF laser used to excite laser-induced fluorescence of PO molecules are presented. Using the AvaSpec-3648 fiber-optic spectrometer installed in the transmission path of the KrF excimer laser radiation, an analysis of the spectral composition of the output laser radiation was carried out. Using the ZEMAX CAD system, the optical design of the system for spectral filtering of KrF laser probing radiation was calculated. Theoretical results of calculating the position of the probe narrow-band radiation beam at the edge of the gain of the KrF laser with a wavelength of 247.8 nm and the broadband spontaneous radiation of the KrF laser in the wavelength range 248.2–248.5 nm are presented. Experimental results for assessing the effectiveness of the spectral filtering unit for probing radiation based on the spatial separation of the spectral components contained in the output radiation in a controlled region of space are presented.

articleTitle: On the Elasto-Optic Constants of Linear Isotropic Dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of photoelasticity theory as applied to linear isotropic dielectrics. Based on fundamental relations, an expression for the elasto-optic constant as a function of dielectric susceptibility is derived. Formulas for calculating the elasto-optic constant are provided for three phases of dielectrics, relying solely on the dielectric constant. Additionally, the maximum value of the elasto-optic constant for the specified media is estimated.

articleTitle: Optimization of Compressive Ghost Imaging in the Terahertz Range Using Correlation-Based Ranking in Optical System Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: One of the current challenges in terahertz (THz) optics is overcoming the limitations of multipixel cameras, which suffer from low sensitivity and resolution. A promising solution lies in the use of single-pixel imaging techniques, employing spatial light modulators (SLMs), particularly the ghost imaging method combined with compressive measurements. This approach enables high-speed imaging comparable to multipixel cameras, while offering a higher signal-to-noise ratio. However, the quality of the reconstructed images is significantly influenced by the characteristics of the illumination patterns generated by the SLM. This paper proposes an optimization strategy for the ghost imaging method, based on ranking orthogonal basis patterns by their correlation coefficients during optical system transmission. This technique improves image quality compared to random pattern selection at the same levels of undersampling in compressive measurement algorithms.

articleTitle: Rapid Determination of Temperature Distribution in Diamond Anvil Cells from Multispectral Camera Images by Fully Connected Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Remote non–contact temperature measurement is an important task that is being solved both in space research and in the study of matter in extreme states in diamond anvil cells. The common approach is the least squares method for the deviation of the measured spectrum and the calculated curve of the spectral density of energy brightness. To determine the temperature and emissivity with minimal uncertainties, a hybrid method was proposed that allows minimizing only one parameter – temperature. In this case, it is possible to determine not only the emissivity, but also the coefficients of the polynomial decomposition of the emissivity. The solving performance problems when processing a large number of image points using neural networks is discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Automation of Ultrasonic Testing Technology for Soldered Joints of Heat Exchanger Elements
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article discusses the automation of ultrasonic echo-pulse method technology for testing soldered joints of heat exchanger elements. The article describes a test object with a complex geometric shape and defects in soldered joints that occur during manufacturing, such as "non-soldering" and "partial non-soldering". The article describes the problems of existing solutions for quality control of soldered joints, which consist in the complexity of positioning the piezoelectric transducer, which leads to insufficient efficiency and reliability of the testing results, which justifies the relevance of the work. Finite element modeling was carried out to establish the dependencies of geometric displacements during positioning of the piezoelectric transducer, based on the results of which an algorithm was developed that allows increasing the efficiency and reliability of the testing results. An experimental testing of the created automated ultrasonic testing system was carried out, which confirmed that the proposed method for automating the technology of ultrasonic testing of soldered joints of heat exchanger elements is more efficient and reliable compared to existing solutions.

articleTitle: Software-Defined Radio Wireless Communication Technology Design. MIMO 4×4 Mode Configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article is dedicated to the design, assembling and laboratory testing of the Software Defined Radio (SDR) layout for the Long-Term Evolution (LTE) 4×4 Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) mode. State-of-the art analysis is followed by the description of assembling of a pair of two-channel Universal Software Radio Peripheral (USRP) B210mini SDR boards into four-channel MIMO 4×4 layout. Time and frequency synchronization is implemented through standalone precise time server Metronome-PTP-1U. This device acts as a source of 1PPS (1 pulse per second) time stamp and 10 MHz frequency standard, which are distributed to a pair of B210mini SDR boards through Metronome-T translator.

articleTitle: Structural and Morphological Analysis of Diamond-Like Carbon Coatings Deposited Using Different Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of diamond-like carbon (DLC) coatings deposited by different methods using Raman spectroscopy and atomic force microscopy (AFM). The unique combination of high hardness and chemical resistance in DLC coatings makes them particularly valuable for advanced optoelectronic devices and precision instrumentation, where these properties enhance device longevity and operational efficiency. The paper examines coatings deposited by hollow-cathode-enhanced magnetron sputtering, pulsed laser deposition (PLD), and cathodic arc deposition with laser ignition of carbon plasma and plasma flow separation (CAD-LICPFS) is used to determine structural features, such as crystallinity and the distribution of sp<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and sp<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> hybridizations. The AFM method allows one to study the surface morphology and evaluate the surface topography of the coatings. The results of the studies show that the deposition method significantly affects the structure and properties of DLC coatings. The obtained data provide valuable insights for optimizing deposition processes to produce high-quality DLC coatings for various industrial applications.

articleTitle: Vehicle Tracking Algorithm of Speed Estimation Based on Traffic Video Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This method offers a solution for vehicle detection and movement analysis in real time or based on video fragments using. The algorithm effectively tracks vehicles and corrects errors that occur during data processing. The main focus is on assessing instantaneous speed, which is critical due to the high responsiveness of modern vehicles. This parameter helps evaluate driving aggressiveness on road sections, and the dynamics of starting from a stop line can aid in optimizing traffic light control. This approach aims to improve traffic flow management and can be applied in intelligent transportation systems and real-time systems.

articleTitle: Application of Students’ Scientific Potential to Modernization of Laboratory Work Complex
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article examines various forms of student involvement in the modernization of the laboratory complex in the disciplines of general communication theory and related academic disciplines in the system of higher technical education. It is shown that this form of work is quite effective for ensuring high-quality training of specialists with engineering and technical education in the field of IT and telecommunications. Examples of a modernized laboratory complex of two laboratory works of the discipline "General Communication Theory" by a group of students under the supervision of teachers of the department are given, the modernization was carried out in the C++ programming language and in the MatLab software environment.

articleTitle: Virtual Radiophysics Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article considers the development of a digital educational platform for doing laboratory works remotely. The platform has been aimed at creating virtual radiophysics laboratory for studying electrodynamic characteristics of microwave devices. The laboratory developed enables the implementation of computer models of modern measuring instruments and devices of microwave and EHF ranges. The computer interface of these models is fully analogous to the interface of real devices and, apart from studying physical processes, it allows the user to gain primary skills in making measurements, similar to those when operating real equipment. The virtual laboratory includes models of modern microwave devices under study. The structure of the laboratory is easily expandable, and adding new devices and measuring instruments does not require software revision. The laboratory features the remote connection and performance of laboratory works. The created software can be used in the educational process when doing special laboratory works on the study of microwave devices as an interactive teaching aid. Due to the remote access, the laboratory can be available to a large number of students and teachers, which provides a new approach to studying engineering and natural sciences taking into account the possibility of doing laboratory works remotely within digital educational environment. The article also provides the information on the practical application of a virtual radiophysics laboratory in the educational process.

articleTitle: Features of Methods for Modifying Cantilevers for Atomic Force Microscopy
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Atomic force microscopy (AFM) is one of the most popular method for surface characterization of solids, composites, polymers, and electronic components used in the road transport complex. The sensitive element of the AFM is a special probe (cantilever). Cantilevers’ improving is the way to expand the AFM efficiency. Different regimes and methods for producing cantilevers with smaller curvature radius are proposed for increasing spatial resolution of AFM. Methods for processing cantilevers to reduce the radius of curvature and increase the resolution are proposed. A method for forming a conductive coating of AFM cantilevers using atomic layer deposition (ALD) has been developed; titanium nitride (TiN) has been selected as the conductive material. Samples of cantilevers with functional coatings based on diamond-like BCx films have been obtained to increase wear resistance. The use of pulsed laser deposition allows one to form a homogeneous diamond-like coating of boron carbide on the probe needle, and also not to affect the back side of the cantilever beam.

articleTitle: Application of Multivariate Curve Resolution analysis and Multilayer Perceptron for Classification of Raman Spectra of the Skin
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This study examines the possibility of using a multilayer perceptron, as well as the expediency of reducing the data dimension using multivariate curve resolution analysis to classify the Raman spectra of the skin. Classification models have been developed for three cases: healthy skin and skin with diseases, benign neoplasms and malignant neoplasms, and malignant melanoma and pigmented nevi. To study the dimensionality reduction of the data, the method of multivariate curve resolution using the alternating least squares (MCR-ALS) method was used. Data were obtained on eight, ten, fifteen and thirty skin components and their relative concentrations in the tested samples, which were used as classification parameters. The effectiveness of the classification models with a different number of parameters was compared. The ROC AUC of the classification varies from 0,60 to 0,87.

articleTitle: Optical Polyspectral Imaging Systems. Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The fundamental principles for classification of systems aimed at recording spectral-spatial optical data are presented. They are based on the principal features and properties of such systems: spectral, spatial, temporal, constructional, exploitation, etc. The list of such classifying groups of properties appears to be complete. The resulting classifier provides accurate and complete identification of any device of the considered class or system, which are usually called just multispectral or hyperspectral without proper clarification. The presented classification allows the user and the manufacturer to determine unambiguously the properties and technical characteristics of such systems. Such features of the classifier as reliability, sufficiency and practical significance are marked.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning Methods to Solve the Problem of Classifying Materials Based on the Results of Measuring their Thermoelectric Power
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper investigates the possibility of using machine learning methods in the analysis of temperature dependences of the thermoelectric power of structural alloys, their clustering and classification for the purpose of subsequent use of these methods in the construction of methods for monitoring the chemical composition of materials. Data on the thermoelectric power of industrial alloy grades used in welding technology are presented. The results of dividing the array of experimental curves into groups using the hierarchical clustering algorithm are presented. General patterns of change in thermoelectric power within each group of alloys are identified and a comparison with the chemical composition of the alloys is made. Training and test data sets for training are prepared and the possibility of classifying a material based on the results of measuring its thermoelectric power is investigated.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Operational Safety of a Passenger Car Automatic Emergency Braking System
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article deals with the state of the issue and outlines the advantages of advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). The structure of vehicle safety, stages and methods of development of safety mechanisms in the leading industry standards on operational and functional safety are described. The general principles of forming methods of describing the electronic control system of the automobile on the example of the automatic emergency braking system of the passenger car are proposed. The factors of operating conditions within the framework of operational design domain (ODD), which should be taken into account in the formation of typical scenarios of car movement, are determined. It is proposed to carry out safety assessment when investigating a limited number of the most dangerous scenarios selected from the total number by means of hazard analysis and risk assessment (HARA) methods, identification and evaluation of initiating events.

Author Keywords: advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) functional safety

articleTitle: Educational and Methodological Complex in Higher Mathematics for Students of Technical Specialties
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The educational and methodological complex in higher mathematics for students of technical specialties with a total labor intensity of 188 classroom hours is considered. The structure of the complex is described in detail, where the content is based on the section of the topic being studied and each section contains a lecture part, a practical lesson and test tasks. Much attention is paid to semester-long individual homework, the content of which is described in detail in the work. Such assignments facilitate students’ independent work to master sections of the course being studied. A special feature of the complex is the possibility of hosting it, which makes it a convenient and flexible online learning system.

articleTitle: Identification of Blood Serum Compound by Decomposition of Raman Spectra by Multivariate Curve Resolution Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Biological samples of tissues or liquids are a mixture of many different biomolecules, each of which contributes to the Raman scattering spectrum of the sample. Separation and identification of pure biochemical components remains one of the most demanded tasks in Raman spectroscopy. The purpose of this study is to explore the possibility of using the multivariate curve resolution method using the alternating least squares (MCR-ALS) for in vitro analysis of Raman spectra of blood serum samples. As a result of the analysis, spectral profiles of the components included in the studied samples were obtained.

articleTitle: The Use of Convolutional Neural Networks to Classify the States of the Maxillary Sinuses in Digital Diaphanoscopy
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The work presents the results of the use of the convolutional neural network ResNet-50 in digital diaphanoscopy for the diagnosis of maxillary sinus conditions. The analysis of registered diaphanograms of patients with sinusitis, cystic fluid and conditionally healthy volunteers was carried out. It is shown that applying the proposed classification model to diaphanograms recorded at a sensing wavelength of 850 nm and fixation threshold of 80% allows to reduce the false negative result. The results analysis made it possible to establish requirements for the registered diaphanograms. An approach to dividing the developed model into static and dynamic components is proposed.

articleTitle: Quantum Blockchain Architecture for Transportation Services
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper explores the integration of quantum computing and blockchain technology to develop a quantum blockchain network architecture specifically designed for transportation services. The convergence of these technologies addresses critical challenges in the transportation sector, such as data security, transaction speed, and scalability. Quantum computing, with its principles of superposition and entanglement, offers unprecedented computational capabilities, while blockchain technology provides a decentralized and secure ledger system. The proposed architecture leverages quantum cryptographic protocols to ensure secure communication channels and data integrity. The framework for transportation services facilitates secure and efficient data exchange between various stakeholders, enhances transaction processing speeds, and supports autonomous operations through smart contracts. These contracts automate tasks such as fare payments, cargo deliveries, and vehicle maintenance scheduling, reducing administrative overhead and improving service quality. Implementing innovative architecture involves addressing several technical challenges, such as scaling quantum hardware, developing robust quantum error correction methods, and integrating quantum and classical systems. Cost and resource considerations are also critical, given the substantial investment required for quantum hardware and the need for specialized expertise. As the technology matures, it promises to provide a secure and efficient foundation for modern transportation services, benefiting stakeholders across the industry.

articleTitle: Method of Online Control of Detonation Properties of Hydrocarbon Fuels
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In recent years, issues of the quality and use of motor gasoline have acquired a completely new meaning and are on a par with the most important problems on the solution of which technical progress and economic development depend. Requirements for the quality of motor gasoline are growing every year and for new engines it is necessary to develop new types with improved performance characteristics. The main requirement for motor gasoline is optimal detonation resistance, i.e. a parameter characterizing the ability of a fuel to resist self-ignition during compression. This is the most important quantitative characteristic of fuel, on the basis of which its grade and applicability in engines of a particular design are determined. For each type of engine, it is necessary to select gasoline that ensures knock-free operation in all modes. Today, for the rapid determination of the detonation properties of motor fuels, the most common are physicochemical methods that connect the occurrence of chemical reactions of the fuels under study with the accompanying physical effects. This article discusses the possibility of using a cold-flame combustion method based on the oxidation reaction of fuel with an oxygen-containing gas, as well as measuring one of the physical effects accompanying the reaction, the magnitude of which is proportional to the detonation properties of this fuel. Research of this method based on the use of a new oxidizer – one of the allotropic modifications of oxygen – ozone – opens up new opportunities for determining the quality of hydrocarbon fuels. From the point of view of improving the quality of products, with a simultaneous increase in the latter, the study of a method based on the reaction of fuel with a specific oxidizer (ozone) obtained directly from the ambient air is of interest, and the issue of developing means of its implementation is relevant.

articleTitle: Uniqueness in Linear Inverse Problems for an Abstract Differential Equation of the Second Order
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: We investigate linear inverse problems for a second-order abstract differential equation in a Banach space. The equation contains an independent on time inhomogeneous term. This term is unknown. At the initial moment of time the Cauchy conditions are added to the differential equation. As additional condition, an overdetermination is specified at the final moment of time. We study problems for various types of the final overdetermination. For each one a uniqueness criterion of a solution is given. These criteria are expressed in spectral terms. Simple sufficient conditions for the uniqueness and the non-uniqueness of a solution are noted. To illustrate the results, some examples are provided. The present review has been prepared as a scientific information for the conference Intelligent technologies and electronic devices in vehicle and road transport complex. This may be useful for establishing interdisciplinary connections as a theoretical basis for modeling complex systems.

articleTitle: Methodology for Training a Neural Network for Recognizing Road Pavement Defects
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper describes a technology for analyzing the data of monitoring objects of the city's street and road network based on automatic detection and classification of the main types of road pavement damage (flatness, cracks, crack grids, potholes, repair maps, markings, and others) using convolutional neural networks. The results of a comparison of software tools used to create neural networks, as well as criteria for selecting libraries necessary for neural network training, are presented. The choice of the Google Colab cloud platform for neural network training is justified and a comparative analysis of its various versions is performed. The parameters of neural network training, statistics of image classification into three groups are given, and an algorithm for preparing input data is proposed. The values of IoU and F1 accuracy metrics by categories (classes) of objects are given. It is concluded that the amount of trained data, expressed as the number of pixels of regions of different classes rather than the number of those regions, is important for the quality of pixel classification.

articleTitle: The Causes and Sources of the Evolution of Engineering Education Competencies in the Field of Electronics and Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper examines the impact of contemporary industrialization paradigms on the evolution of technical professionals' skill sets. By analyzing the foundational aspects of manufacturing under Industry 4.0 and Industry 5.0 paradigms, it identifies significant shifts in the nature and structure of manufacturing processes, facilitating the advancement into a novel phase of civilizational growth characterized by the integration and utilization of sophisticated technologies, cyber-physical systems, and cognitive frameworks. This necessitates the acquisition of novel competencies for effective human-machine-object interoperability. To ensure the adequacy of engineers' competencies to new functional and technological requirements, the authors substantiate the professional tasks of specialists in the field of ICT, communication systems and radio engineering. A gamification approach to the formation of new knowledge is proposed, including a set of game situations for training specialists in technical fields, an algorithm and principles of their application.

Author Keywords: functional and technological evolution of factors of production

articleTitle: Determining the Time and Volume of Supply of Materials for the Production of Asphalt Concrete Mixtures
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper deals with material supply scheduling models for asphalt concrete mix production. It is shown that planning the supply of raw materials relies primarily on the economic criterion, which is considered the minimum expected average loss, including the cost of material storage and loss of profits due to lack of materials in storage at the right time. The most common systems are described that allow automating the processes of planning, inventory control, and choosing the best strategy for restocking materials for the entire assortment to minimize the actual losses or anticipated costs. Models are presented to determine the losses from the storage of materials in the asphalt concrete plant warehouse and the losses incurred due to their absence.

articleTitle: Research on Using Deep Learning for Transport Demand Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This research explores the application of deep learning techniques as a prominent Data Mining methodology for constructing a predictive model of transport demand. Beyond access to high-quality data, analysts face challenges in consolidating computational resources and integrating foreign software with domestic systems. Key aspects in model development involve utilizing existing algorithms for data analysis through a classifier object. The classifier is then trained on various datasets, including those generated and collected from road transport infrastructure devices. Simultaneously, patterns of respondents' movements along randomly selected routes or digitally designed paths are investigated. Predicting transport demand through probability functions for collecting and analyzing passenger transaction datasets is crucial for transport infrastructure and service planning. In modern multimodal transport systems, transport demand distribution between modes is the result of individual users' random choices from available alternatives. Deep data analysis in transport networks optimizes system efficiency and safety. Advanced data collection technologies (sensors, GPS, monitoring systems) provide extensive information for improved route planning, traffic forecasting, enhanced resource utilization, and innovative transport infrastructure management strategies. Data mining plays a pivotal role in predicting transport demand in behavioral models, enabling extraction of valuable insights from large passenger and traveler behavior datasets. Various data mining methods and models facilitate identification of hidden patterns, trends, and correlations in transport demand, ultimately enhancing forecasting accuracy and system optimization. By employing clustering analysis, researchers can identify passenger groups with similar preferences, facilitating targeted service strategies. Classification models enable prediction of transport service demands for different demographic groups or time periods. Associative rule analysis reveals connections between factors like ticket prices, schedules, and seasonal fluctuations, aiding in optimal pricing and resource management. Anomaly detection methods identify unusual transport demand patterns, allowing for swift responses to changes and risk minimization. In conclusion, data mining significantly contributes to transport demand prediction in behavioral models, offering more accurate and efficient solutions for managing transport systems and improving passenger service quality.

articleTitle: Acousto-Optical Spectroanalyzer on Azimuthally Inhomogeneous Bessel Light Beams
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The main characteristics of an acousto-optic spectrum analyzer with spatial integration based on Bessel light beams in paratellurite crystals are investigated. The diffraction efficiency was investigated and expression for one was derived, that depends from the parameters of o- and e-type Bessel beams, and from overlap integrals values and the frequency detuning of the Bragg synchronism. The absence of exact transverse phase matching of diffracted Bessel light beams leads to the frequency resolution of the acousto-optic spectrum analyzer is ~ 3.5 kHz. It is found that the upper limit of the dynamic range of the spectrum analysis is proportional to the square of the overlap integral of the diffracted Bessel light beams. It is shown that with an increase in the mode order of the Bessel light beam, the type of the amplitude-frequency characteristic of the device does not change in the presence and absence of transverse synchronism of the diffracted light beams of zero and first order.

articleTitle: Intelligent Road Surface Repair Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper proposes an approach for intelligent pavement repair scheduling depending on the calculated pavement condition index (PCI). Basic methods for predicting PCI values that take into account quality indicators, age, and deflection of the pavement surface are reviewed. Regardless of the calculation method chosen, the PCI values obtained allow estimating the extent of roadway deterioration. Pavement remaining service life prediction methods are also described to predict the dynamics of pavement deterioration over time. A methodology for intelligent pavement repair scheduling is presented, which includes the possibility of selecting three different scheduling modes. A heuristic algorithm that implements this methodology for scheduling repairs is proposed. As an example, the determination of pavement condition based on the calculated PCI index values is given.

articleTitle: Spectral Thermography Techniques for Melt Pool Thermal Imaging in Electron Beam Additive Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: Thermal imaging of an object in a real-time mode is relevant for many technological processes, especially in additive manufacturing of metal parts. Accuracy of the obtained data on the temperature distribution determines further decisions on the selection of optimal operating modes additive manufacturing machines. Thermal monitoring of the melt pool may allow appropriate adjusting the machine parameters to reduce the risk of formation of various defect types in monoalloys and composites. This paper is devoted to the comparison of common spectral imaging techniques for in situ thermal imaging of melt pool in additive manufacturing of metal parts. We propose the significant criteria for comparative analysis of the common techniques and assessment of their applicability for real-time monitoring of electron beam additive manufacturing.

articleTitle: Experimental Determination of the Effectiveness of the Lane Support System
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The classification of lane support systems (LSS) is considered. An overview of LSS test methods is given. The results of the LSS system efficiency assessment on a straight section with intermittent road markings are presented. The test method is developed based on the EuroNCAP protocol. The experimental study was performed on a Nissan Pathfinder R53 equipped with the Propilot driver assistance system. A description of the vehicle LSS system operation is given. Vector Informatik GmbH equipment was used to collect test data. The tests were performed at the NAMI test center. Evaluation indicators of LSS efficiency are proposed. A graphical recording of vehicle motion parameters in a typical test maneuver is presented.

articleTitle: Scientometric Analysis of the TIRVED-2024 Conference Papers Reviewing Results
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The use of technology for analyzing scientometric indicators of individual scientists and universities plays an important role in organizational systems management in terms of scientific organizations' publication programs implementation. This article continues a series of studies by the authors aimed at establishing a connection between formal scientometric indicators of article authors and the success of peer-review process. In article analyzes the results of peer-reviewing from TIRVED-2024 international conference, held with the technical support of IEEE, whose articles are being prepared for publication in the IEEEXplore electronic library. The distribution of indicators by conference sections and scientometric analysis of conference materials by the Hirsch index of authors and organizations are carried out.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Acoustic Emission Sources Linear Location Based on Constructing the Acoustic Signal Envelope Via the Hilbert Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper addresses the methodological aspects of constructing acoustic emission (AE) sources linear localizations. At the solving the problem initial stage, a series of experimental studies were conducted to determine the average relative standard localization algorithm error. To reduce the error in determining the AE event sources coordinates, the authors propose an algorithm for refining the acoustic signal registration time, the basis of constructing the envelope of the acoustic emission pulse via the Hilbert transform. The proposed approach was validated through the linear location of AE sources generated via a Su-Nielsen simulator. To minimize the influence of the electronic path phase-frequency characteristics on the AE pulse parameters, the acoustic signals were recorded with a dual-channel oscilloscope at a sampling rate of f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf> = 200 MHz. A comparison of the standard and proposed algorithms reveled that the average reduced error in constructing the linear location decreased from 5.7% to 1.8%.

articleTitle: Dataset Annotation Converter for Training Neural Networks to Detect Defects on Various Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper discusses the development of a converter to transform RLE (Run Length Encoded) data into a format suitable for training the YOLO neural network, which is used for real-time object detection. The converter is applied to datasets of road surface damages and defects on metal sheets. The results demonstrate the converter's effectiveness in preparing annotations that enable YOLO to accurately detect defects on monotone surfaces. The authors applied their converter to the Severstal dataset, illustrating how to merge and organize data for training and validation. An example of a trained neural network demonstrates its ability to accurately detect small defects on metal sheets after 30 epochs of training, showing confidence levels for each identified object.

articleTitle: Development of a Pedestrian Target for Testing Driver Assistance Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article is devoted to the issue of creating a mobile pedestrian target for testing active driver assistance systems and unmanned vehicles. Working out various road situations is the basis for confirming the functionality of the car. And for unmanned vehicles, this is one of the final stages of safety testing and confirmation of operational characteristics. Systems specially designed for use in field testing conditions allow to increase the number of scenarios, and thereby improve the quality of checking the operation of algorithms from the point of view of functional safety of unmanned vehicles. The article describes in detail the requirements for a pedestrian target based on international standards. The article discusses the methods of testing driver assistance systems with the participation of vulnerable road users. The authors presented a description of the manufactured prototype of a pedestrian target and a foot drive control system.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Propagation of Annular and Laguerre-Gaussian Beams in the Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The calculation and analysis of passing of annular beams and Laguerre-Gaussian beams through the atmosphere are conducted. Annular beams are formed by the optical scheme with two axicons. The calculation showed that in a rather large range of distances the maximal intensity of annular beams is higher than of Laguerre-Gaussian beams. The scheme is considered when in the receiving plane a Fourier-transforming lens with one-mode fiber in a focal plane is situated. Scintillation indices are calculated of field power in lens plane and fiber plane.

articleTitle: Blockchain in Education: a New Approach to Storing and Verification of Academic Works
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper explores the role of blockchain technologies in the field of education for storing and verifying students’ academic works. Blockchain is a promising technology for solving problems related to data security, transparency and accessibility, especially in the context of scientific research and education. The paper proposes an architecture for a coursework storage system based on blockchain and NFT technology. A description of technologies and system development tools is provided. The main stages of the systems’ work are considered. The advantages and prospects of blockchain systems in the field of education and science are analyzed.

articleTitle: Method for Regularized Estimation of the Optical Flow Velocity Field in Computer Vision Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: For computer vision systems that use monocular methods for determining the motion of a video camera based on algorithms for calculating optical flow parameters are proposed method velocity field estimates that are resistant to spatiotemporal interference. The current estimate of the optical flow parameters is formed by minimization of the integrand augmented energy functionality regularizing components: according to Tikhonov and taking into account the continuity of the velocity field in time. In comparison with the known procedure for estimating the velocity field by minimizing full energy functionality using optical flow values for the entire scanning area and requiring a significant amount of calculations, the implementation of the proposed method uses optical flow measurements at only one point in the scene. The simple analytical form of the obtained solution is easily implemented in on-board computers. The conducted numerical experiment illustrates the possibility of practical application of the proposed approach in computer vision systems ensuring the functioning of the systems spatial orientation and positioning of autonomous devices general purpose robots, Earth surface sensing complexes electrodynamic, mechanical, and other systems.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Efficiency of Using a Diesel and Electric Loader Taking into Account the Resource Limitations of the Battery
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper compares diesel and electric wheel loaders in terms of operating costs, productivity and environmental impact. The study found that despite the higher initial investment in electric loaders, their long-term operating costs are lower due to lower energy consumption and no fuel costs. Electric loaders also show slightly better performance and environmental benefits. However, to fully understand the economic and operational benefits of electric loaders, the additional costs of maintenance, charging infrastructure and battery replacement must be considered. The results of the study indicate that electric loaders are a promising choice for companies looking to reduce operating costs and improve environmental performance, with further research into specific costs required for a more accurate assessment.

articleTitle: On One Algorithm in the Generalized Artin Tree Group
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The construction of algorithms and their implementation are one of the important parts of various scientific fields, including combinatorial group theory. In this paper, we consider an algorithm for finding the intersection of subgroups, each of which is generated by one element, in a generalized tree Artin group, which represents the tree product of Artin groups whose graph is a tree, on the one hand, and Artin groups of extra-large type, on the other, with isomorphic subgroups, each from which is generated by some generator of these groups. The results considered in this paper can be used in the further study of Artin groups, in particular, the study their various algorithmic properties, and also contribute to the development of intelligent technologies. Artin groups also find their application in the construction of some cryptosystems, in particular, this applies to the famous braid group, which is part of the class under consideration.

articleTitle: Control System for Operating Modes of Fiber Lead Bending Formers
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: In order to monitor, measure or receive a signal via feedback, it is necessary to branch off a part of the output power of the emitter from the main transmission channel. This branch is used as a control signal intended to control the output power level of the emitter, as well as to separate or combine radiation flows. Based on the analysis, the shortcomings of existing works were identified and a control system for the operating modes of fiber optic bend formers was developed.
