This system allows for connecting one of the optical transmitting modules with a long wavelength and low attenuation of the fiber optic, extracting information by receiving a signal corresponding to the level of branched radiation, determining the locations and masses of the penetrating object depending on the intensity of the branched radiation and, via the feedback circuit, automatically adjusting the output power level of the emitter.

articleTitle: Using Specialized Corpora in Teaching English for Specific Purposes to Students of Posgraduate Engineering Program
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The purpose of the study was to assess the prospects of applying the corpus-based approach to teaching subject-specific terminology to postgraduate students. The study involved conducting an experiment, during which the participants were assigned to the control and experimental groups. The control group was taught using the traditional approach, while the experimental group learned to use corpus technologies and completed vocabulary tasks that required addressing corpora. In addition, participants in the experimental group developed do-it-yourself (DIY) corpora using AntConc software to expand the vocabulary related to the topics of their scientific research. The results show that postgraduate students who were taught using the corpus-based approach significantly improved their reading and writing skills and retained the subject-specific vocabulary better. The survey data indicate an overall positive attitude among postgraduate students towards using corpora. The developed exercises can be of value to subsequent postgraduate degree programs and master degree programs if adapted.

articleTitle: Development of a Method for Robotic Sorting of Metal Objects
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper presents a method for the robotic sorting of objects in automatic mode, which makes use of the Kuka industrial manipulator. The method proposed in this work performs the segmentation of objects using a neural network, the selection and the determination of the spatial coordinates of the picking object, and the movement of the manipulator and control of the picking device. The results of the tests demonstrated that the proposed method was able to accurately determine the spatial coordinates of the object with minimal error. Furthermore, the Euler angles of the object centre were calculated with an error of 1.73° on the X-axis and 1.77° on the Y-axis. The findings indicate the potential for extending the scope of applications for industrial manipulators. The results demonstrate the feasibility of employing these manipulators in intricate and congested environments, enabling the sorting of object.

articleTitle: Research of Neural Networks ChatGPT Used to Generate Code in Python Programming Language
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article deals with the problem associated with the influence of a prompt composed by users on the efficiency of the generated program code. The aim of the research is to work out a methodology allowing to analyze the operation and to estimate the effectiveness of online neural network services generating program code. The object of the study is neural network online services that allow generating program code. The subject of the study is the quality indicators of the generated program code. The relevance of the study is due to the increasing use of neural network technologies, including software development. To achieve this goal, the article considers online neural network services "ChatGPT 3.5", "ChatGPT 4" and "ChatGPT 4o", that allow generating program code in a programming language Python in question-and-answer form, besides, in this study, a methodology has been developed that allows determining the efficiency of neural network tools used to generate program code. In order to test this methodology, tasks of different levels of complexity were introduced into the above-mentioned neural network services and the program code generated by them was analyzed. In conclusion, a comparative analysis of the experimental results is conducted, the advantages and disadvantages of the considered neural network techniques in generating program code are identified. The methodological basis of the article includes the following methods: theoretical analysis, description, comparison and experiment.

articleTitle: Evaluating Consistency of Image Generation Models with Vector Similarity
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper presented an approach for evaluating image generation models by measuring their consistency in producing similar results across multiple prompts and seeds. We proposed a method that utilizes image vectorization models to convert generated images into vectors, which are then compared using similarity scores. By analyzing the consistency of generation results, we aimed to provide insights into the randomness of image generation and its potential impact on tasks such as animation, concept art, and blueprint creation. Our findings offer valuable considerations for practitioners working with image generation models, particularly when consistency is crucial for specific applications. We calculated the impact of seed randomness and prompt variation on generation consistency, providing insights into the stability and reliability of image generation. Our results show that with a random seed using a highly descriptive prompt approach generally leads to more consistent generation results compared to the incremented seed, where the difference in consistency was mostly negligible. The proposed evaluation technique leverages advanced image-to-vector conversion techniques to transform generated images into numerical representations. These vectorized outputs are subsequently analyzed using sophisticated similarity metrics, allowing researchers to quantify the degree of consistency between images produced under different conditions. By systematically comparing the output of image generation models under multiple prompts and random seed values, this investigation aims to shed light on the inherent randomness present in current state-of-the-art image synthesis methods. The findings of this study have significant implications for various applications where consistency is paramount, including high-fidelity animation production, conceptual artwork creation, and architectural blueprint design. However, our proposed method also has limitations to consider. The choice of image vectorization model and similarity metric can affect the results, so it is important to make all comparable tests with the same img2vec model. Future research in this field could be used to better understand how consistency in image generation relates to other factors such as model architecture, training data, and prompt complexity.

articleTitle: Software for Visualization of Cellular Automata Models in Traffic Flow Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The paper focuses on creating software for visualization of traffic flows simulated with the help of cellular automata. The presented visualization system named TrafficFlowViz3D enables studying traffic dynamics, generating vehicle behavior scenarios, identifying bottlenecks and jams, and also investigating various traffic management measures for further optimization. The code is developed using the cross-platform Unity 3D engine. The Nagel-Schreckenberg model generalized for heterogeneous flows on multi-lane highways underlies the program. Constructing lattices of arbitrary sizes with different cell shapes in 3D space is possible for a comprehensive study of transport systems with complex road geometry. The program is equipped with a graphical interface that allows users to set initial system parameters and obtain important traffic statistics. The paper considers in detail the class architecture proposed for the efficient implementation and visualization of the model. Application of the A* algorithm and its interaction with the Nagel-Schreckenberg model are also discussed. Some test predictions are analyzed to verify the developed software and confirm its high capabilities.

articleTitle: Spectral Data Filtering to Increase its Discriminative Power
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The methodology of two-criteria optimization of comparative analysis of nonstationary spectral data observed against the background of normally distributed and uncorrelated additive interference is considered. The data is subjected to both linear and nonlinear filtering. The dependence of the similarity measures of the observed and reference spectral data on the linear filtration coefficients is found by maximizing the criterion of the likelihood ratio of the presence and absence of reference data, and the coefficients themselves by maximizing the criterion of discriminating ability: the ratio of similarity measures between the same and different data. The proposed methods for linear filtering provide the same reliability of their distinction as the well-known correlation methods of consistent filtering, but with exceeding the threshold level of interference. With nonlinear filtering, the effect of "over-discrimination" is obtained, when the reliability of distinguishing data is ensured by exceeding the threshold level of interference several times compared with linear filtering

articleTitle: Service Model of Megalopolis Traffic Flow Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This article describes approaches to innovation in the transport industry by the example of describing the principles of implementation of a service model for collecting, processing and consolidating information on traffic flows, including for the purpose of forming automated forecast reports. The relevance of the topic under consideration lies in the peculiarities of the development and mass introduction of innovative technologies in the transport industry associated with the high length of motorways, the regulatory framework under development, and the provision of road safety. This paper considers an approach to the implementation of the service aimed at providing information on key parameters of the traffic flow to users interested in this information. In this case, the introduction of new methods of use, existing and implemented technical, technological and digital solutions allows for the rapid realisation of the innovative potential of the transport industry. The implementation of the service model of collection, processing and consolidation of information on traffic flows will allow for better and more efficient implementation of processes related to the organisation and safety of road traffic, formation of forecasts on the traffic situation, as well as, in the future, to provide operational information to connected, highly automated and fully unmanned vehicles.

Author Keywords: subsystem for monitoring of traffic flow parameters

articleTitle: Assessment of the Impact of Materials and Production Technology on the Durability of Asphalt Concrete Structural Layers of Road Clothing
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper discusses the influence of the materials included in the asphalt concrete mixture and its production technology on the quality of asphalt concrete and, consequently, on the durability of the road surface. It is shown that the condition of road pavement depends on many parameters: the quality of initial materials, production technology, operating conditions, as well as climatic features of the region. An example of defects roads that are directly related not only to the quality of materials, but also to external factors such as traffic intensity, temperature fluctuations, and humidity is given. Continuous improvements in materials and construction methods create more durable and resilient roadways, which ultimately contributes to better infrastructure and better lives for citizens. The need to continue the work on prediction and research of performance indicators using modern data analysis methods to improve the remaining life of roads is shown.

articleTitle: Determination of Traffic Flow Parameters Using High-Precision Positioning System to Improve Traffic Efficiency and Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article analyses the application of high-precision positioning system (HPPS) to determine the main parameters of traffic flow in order to improve the efficiency and safety of road traffic. The paper considers methods of determining the average speed, traffic intensity, density and composition of traffic flow using high-precision positioning. It describes the general principle of operation, techniques and advantages of using HPPS and technology for determining traffic flow parameters using HPPS, and further application of the data obtained for traffic optimisation. The conclusion describes the advantages and disadvantages of using high-precision positioning subsystems for determining traffic flow parameters and further development prospects.

articleTitle: Methodology for Detecting Anomalous Traffic Flows in the Network Based on the Hurst Parameter
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: This paper investigates the use of the Hurst index for traffic flow analysis based on data from intelligent transportation system (ITS) detectors. The values of Hurst index (H) for different time intervals during the day ranged from 0,1295 to 0,4178, indicating the presence of antipersistence and trendiness in certain time periods. These results confirm that the Hurst index can be applied for predictive analytics and adjusting traffic light modes to prevent traffic congestion. A comparison of the results of different data analysis methods and data from different regions has revealed significant differences, which emphasizes the importance of considering the specifics of transportation systems in the analysis. The Hurst index estimation methodology has proven to be an effective tool for identifying anomalies in traffic flows and optimizing traffic management, especially when compared to alternative methods.

articleTitle: Development of Methods for Monitoring and Predicting the Safety of Automated Vehicles in Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Technologies and Electronic Devices in Vehicle and Road Transport Complex (TIRVED)
abstract: The article studies technologies of storage, processing, remote high-speed transmission, analysis and verification of large amounts of data suitable for use in the field of automotive telematics. The methods of collection, storage, structuring and maintenance of statistics of automated vehicles operation data are described. The logic of structuring and archiving of data streams coming from the server is given. Diagnostics and forecasting of the technical condition of automated vehicles is proposed to be carried out on the basis of data on errors in the standard systems of vehicles, data on failures and failures in the systems included in the automated driving system and on the basis of dynamic control parameters. The developed algorithm for predicting the risks of failures and malfunctions of units and systems affecting safety on the basis of operation data is presented. The approach to identification and forecasting of incorrect parameters of automated vehicles functioning affecting safety is proposed, in particular, the algorithm of analyzing the delay time of the control signal on steering of the automated vehicle on the basis of operation data is developed. The adequacy of the developed algorithm has been verified using the operation data of automated vehicles on public roads, the results of which allow us to assert that this method can be effectively applied to predict the technical condition of automated vehicles.
